canDoYue: 你識講咳嗽同過敏，仲識問劑量同飯後食藥。
canDoEn: Describe a cough and an allergy, then ask about the dosage and taking a tablet after meals.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我今日咳得好犀利，想喺呢間藥房買啲藥。
dialogue.say: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: What symptom can I note for the pharmacist before we choose a box?
dialogue.glossYue: 揀盒之前，我可以幫藥劑師記低邊個症狀？
dialogue.say: What symptom can I note for the pharmacist before we choose a box?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The only extra symptom is a drug allergy, and this bad cough is exactly why I walked in here, Mei.
dialogue.glossYue: 另外就係藥物過敏，我係因為呢陣咳先入嚟搵你，Mei。
dialogue.say: The only extra symptom is a drug allergy, and this bad cough is exactly why I walked in here, Mei.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What dosage can I follow here, and may I ask about meals?
dialogue.glossYue: 劑量點跟，同埋可唔可以問下食飯？
dialogue.say: What dosage can I follow here, and may I ask about meals?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.
dialogue.glossYue: 劑量係一日兩次，每次一粒細藥片，食五日。
dialogue.say: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I take that one tablet after meals if it is safer?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果安全啲，我可唔可以飯後食嗰一粒藥片？
dialogue.say: Can I take that one tablet after meals if it is safer?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Yes, after meals is safer, and this box needs no prescription.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，飯後食安全啲，呢盒唔使處方。
dialogue.say: Yes, after meals is safer, and this box needs no prescription.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will call this pharmacy if that cough comes back after I rest.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果休息之後咳又返，我會打畀呢間藥房。
dialogue.say: I will call this pharmacy if that cough comes back after I rest.
